column3: PYRON M2 FREEZE (14z-76, maintainer playtest + measured, 2026-08-10). = pyron-m1 plus his EFFECT palette block. Delta is EXACTLY two ops: data_file 0x3faba0 (vs2 0x3AC45C, len 0xDC0, into hole_b) + poke32 0x38c25c -> 0x003faba0, i.e. row 0x11 of the effect-palette pointer table. THE PREMISE THAT DEFERRED THIS FOR TWO SESSIONS IS RETRACTED: 0x38C218 was believed to have only SIXTEEN rows, so a variant id would 'index past it' into an adjacent shared table at 0x38C258. It is ONE 32-ROW table indexed by the full character id — the five id-indexing sites take the raw id byte with no mask or fold; 0x38C258 (and 0x38C1D8) have ZERO references in either ROM view; and both tables' variant halves alias the base half except at rows 0x12 and 0x18, which are Oboro Bishamon and its sibling, variant datasets vsav genuinely ships. So row 0x11 is an ordinary variant alias row that legacy never indexes (tests/audit_id_writers.sh), exactly like the sprite row pyron-m1 already carried. Frozen by tests/test_effect_palette_table.sh (4 negative controls). VISIBILITY was NOT decidable by any automated leg — 0 reads of any character's effect block across two full vanilla fighting replays and a 6000-frame Pyron soak, against a live positive control of 60 reads on his sprite block; it is a rare-event palette whose only trigger is the electrocute/status path, which no replay produces. MAINTAINER PLAYTEST decided it: Pyron's shock aura is RED on pyron19 and YELLOW on pyron20, matching vs2; and DEMITRI (whose block Pyron was borrowing, id 0x11 aliasing row 0x01) is identical across both builds and correct — the legacy check no RAM gate can make, because the palette path never transits work RAM. Rebuilds bit-exact from build/manifest/pyron.toml at TENANT_CHAR=0x11 stage 6 --profile cps2-wide-v1 (verified into a scratch dir).
